implementation.upgrade: bounded caller-supplied inference runtime profile normalized and hashed into route plans and bound outcome receipts; profile mismatch, missing profile, unsupported values, route tampering, generation errors, freshness errors, and replay fail closed

runtime_profile_schema.authority: caller-supplied runtime evidence only; not provider authority, hardware proof, model correctness, or execution permission

measured_validation.benchmark_scope: local deterministic route planning, profile normalization, digest binding, and receipt admission; excludes model, network, cryptographic-provider, browser, tool, accelerator, and kernel inference latency

limitations: Runtime profiles are caller-supplied descriptions and are not attested observations of an engine, cache, accelerator, quantization mode, or model behavior.
The profile contract does not call vLLM, SGLang, Dynamo, OpenAI, Anthropic, or any other provider and does not mint credentials or authorize tools.
The benchmark measures Python control-plane overhead only; runtime-profile binding adds material overhead and requires future optimization or caching.
No physical accelerator qualification, distributed profile consensus, remote attestation, KMS proof, or cross-node clock discipline is claimed.
This evidence does not claim AGI, production approval, inference superiority, model correctness, or real-world task completion.
